name: Departing-employee knowledge capture
summary: When someone is leaving or changing role, their manager gets an interview guide aimed at what only that person knows, then a handover document the successor can work from, every point traced to the conversations and marked with how sure it is. Nothing is shared until the manager approves.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own rules for prepared work and the two-stage form of this one: the manager's area list as the only authority, stated column headers with a stop when one does not match, every point traced to a numbered note, every gap written as a question for the manager, personal matters kept out, and nothing booked, recorded, shared or assigned until a person decides.

sources.contribution: Weighing knowledge by who else holds it, how far it is written down and what depends on it; questions on relationships, process and the wider organization, including ideas tried before and dropped; the conversation treated as the company learning, never as an appraisal; never assuming someone else knows; the person's account checked against documents and colleagues; a write-up per area covering when it comes up, departures from the usual way, who else to ask, what is written and how far to trust it, marked unfinished until checked.
